Path 2, ClaudeGOALS §3

Claude API and Amazon Bedrock

The model calls behind every agent we host: direct from Anthropic, or through AWS.

WHAT IT IS

The Messages API with tool use, prompt caching, batch processing and structured outputs. The same models are offered through Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Direct: newest features first. Bedrock: the AWS IAM, billing and private networking we already govern, with IRSA and no static keys; some features arrive later. Prompt caching and batch are the big cost levers on either.

WHERE WE STAND

We recommend Bedrock with IRSA, with a gateway in front either way. ⚠️ Check current pricing and feature availability on both first.
